# Application Inference from Packet Flows

Header-derived traffic statistics from encrypted packet traces for classifying mobile application flows (facebook, google, instagram, mozilla, x, youtube). Two tasks: task1_static (full-flow) and task2_realtime_prefix5 (first-5-packet). From the ITU AI/ML Challenge; test labels are held by organizers. No IPs, DNS, SNI, Host, URLs or payloads are included.
